name: Commercial Fish Cooking Temperature Chart & Seafood Safety Guide
primary_keyword: fish cooking temperature chart uk commercial kitchen
secondary_keywords: white fish safe core temperature haccp
search_intent: Head chefs, fishmongers, and seafood restaurant cooks seeking authoritative UK statutory core probe temperatures (63°C for 2 min / 70°C for 2m / 82°C Scotland), Regulation (EC) No 853/2004 parasite freezing controls, and flaking doneness benchmarks.

competitors.name: Food Standards Agency (FSA)
competitors.features: Broad regulatory statement with 63°C fish time-temperature combinations; no cut-specific timers.

competitors.name: High Speed Training
competitors.features: Static educational table with course promotion; lacks parasite freeze certification steps.

competitors.name: Seafish UK
competitors.features: Trade body guidance for fish processing; lacks commercial chef interactive kitchen tools.

competitors.name: Thermapen / ETI UK
competitors.features: Thermometer reference chart without weight calculations or print-ready kitchen sign-offs.

competitors.name: FoodDocs
competitors.features: Paywalled compliance software ($79/mo) requiring account registration.

competitors_lack: No interactive weight-based roasting and poaching calculator for catering volumes
No cut-specific seafood selector (salmon fillet, white cod, seared rare tuna, whole fish, fish cakes)
No clear guidance on Regulation (EC) No 853/2004 parasite freezing controls (-20°C for 24h / -35°C for 15h)
No printable high-contrast A4 commercial kitchen wall chart with supervisor sign-off
our_differentiators: Interactive commercial cooking calculator with dedicated fish species profile
Rigorous parasite lethality guide covering Anisakis simplex and scombroid histamine controls
Scottish Food Hygiene regulations toggle (82°C instant core lethality)
Print-ready high-contrast A4 poster with calibration and supervisor signature blocks
